text: Hyundai Motor Company and its related parties (including Hyundai Mobis and Kia) are the largest shareholders of KOSPI-listed Hyundai Motor Securities, holding 39.94% (Hyundai Motor 22.17%, Hyundai Mobis 13.70%, Kia 3.95%), per a disclosure reported in August 2026.
short: Hyundai Motor side is Hyundai Motor Securities' largest shareholder with 39.94%.

source.name: 디지털투데이 (DigitalToday): 현대차증권, 최대주주 현대자동차 측 주식등 보유 비율 0.03%p 증가 [Hyundai Motor Securities: largest shareholder Hyundai Motor side raises stake to 39.94%]
source.quote: 현대차증권(001500)의 최대주주 현대자동차 측은 주식등 보유 비율이 39.94%로 증가했다고 5일 공시했다
source.note: Article reproduces the bulk-ownership report: Hyundai Motor 22.17%, Hyundai Mobis 13.70%, Kia 3.95%. 'Hyundai Motor side' = Hyundai Motor plus six named related parties.
